facts.fact: MTN Mobile Money Benin, a mobile money service, tells customers it is in service and its account ceilings change from 2 November 2026.

MTN Mobile Money Benin says its customers can send and receive money through PI-SPI to more than 170 authorised participants (banks, e-money institutions, microfinance, payment institutions) from 2 November 2026.

note: No national switch stated: PI-SPI is the BCEAO's regional system.
